title: A Few Moments of Cheers' Studio Hurray! Animates Wondering Mate Net Shorts
content:
Hurray! , one of the animation studios for A Few Moments of Cheers film, is planning and animating Wondering Mate , an original short anime that will premiere on Meta Taxi's YouTube channel on December 16. Meta Taxi is streaming an English-subtitled teaser:

Meta Taxi describes the anime's story, set in another world where avatars from discontinued apps live:

Aco, a high school girl avatar who dreams of becoming human, and Bit, an avatar who wants nothing to do with becoming human. A story of two avatars who may be changing, in a world that was never supposed to change.

Yuno Nakahara plays Aco, and Nobuhiko Okamoto plays Bit.

Inu Hirayama, a member of the comedy sketch duo TentenHanten, is making his anime scripting debut with this project. Kodansha 's Shunsuke Sagawa and DNP's Saki Nakao are producing.

Meta Taxi is a YouTube channel that streams talk sessions with guests on various topics — only the sessions are set in a virtual taxi roaming Tokyo at night. Wondering Mate is Meta Taxi's first original short anime, and it will have 12 3-minute episodes.
author: ANN

title: Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Anime Reveals Main Visual and Voice Cast
content:
CODE GEASS Star Chaser Aspal new anime revealed the main key visual, along with the main voice cast members. The anime was announced in September, with the release date set for 2027.

Kazuya Nomura is directing the project, with Mado Nozaki handling series composition. Rolua is responsible for the character designs, while Yoshi. is designing the Agalmata. SUNRISE is credited with the original work, planning and animation production. The main voice cast includes:

• Ivan Shibata as Aspal

• Hibiku Yamamura as Zoé

You can see the new visual below.

You can watch the teaser trailer below.

Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion is an original anime series by studio SUNRISE. Goro Taniguchi directed it, with Ichiro Okouchi writing the script. CLAMP was in charge of the original character designs. The first season aired from October 2006 to July 2007, while the sequel titled Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2 aired from April 2008 to September 2008. They had 25 episodes each. The franchise has a multitude of OVA side stories, manga and light novel adaptations, as well as several movies. A recap movie trilogy released between 2017 and 2018, but it was set in an alternate universe and changed some things from the TV anime. The movies were followed by an original sequel movie titled Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection in 2019. The latest anime for the franchise was the Code Geass: Rozé of the Recapture movie. It released over 4 parts from May to August 2024, with an episodic version also sreaming on Disney from June 21, 2024.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Fool Night' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website of the Fool Night original net anime unveiled additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Thursday. The anime adapting Kasumi Yasuda 's sci-fi drama manga will debut worldwide exclusively on Netflix on November 26.

Cast Sumi Matsuno: Shion Wakayama ( Dandadan ) Ken Hikasa: Hiroshi Tsuchida ( Usagi Drop ) Nishi: Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Mei Okumura: Sayaka Senbongi ( Dungeon Meshi ) Ivy: Yumiko Kobayashi ( Soul Eater )

Music group Tempalay ( Sand Land: The Series ending theme) is performing the opening theme "Shake! spit out." Singer Nowlu ( Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou ) is performing the ending theme "Iki." The opening theme is previewed in the first promotional video below.

Atsushi Yukawa ( Suzume no Tojimari episode director) helms the anime at Sunrise and Shaft . Jin Tanaka ( [Oshi no Ko] ) is handling the series composition and Robert Satou is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katou ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Yasuda began serializing the sci-fi drama in Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan published the 13th volume on June 30.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in October 2023 and released the tenth volume on September 15. The 11th volume is planned to go on sale on December 15.

PV 1

title: Fool Night Anime's Trailer Reveals Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled a new trailer, visual, theme song artists, and additional cast for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Thursday. The main trailer previews the opening theme song "Shake! spit out" by the band Tempalay :

Nowlu performs the ending theme song "Iki" (Breath).

The newly announced cast includes:

Previously announced cast members include:

• Kōki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya

• Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai

• Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka

• Aya Endō as Saeko Kanaeno

• Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi

Atsuyuki Yukawa ( Suzume unit director) is directing the anime at Sunrise and SHAFT . Jin Tanaka ( Oshi no Ko ) is writing the script. Robert Satō is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katō ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Ryō Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryō Kikuchi

• Art Director: Maki Takano (J.C. Staff)

• Color Design: Jin Hibino

• Director of Photography: Mana Ishikawa (animocaramel), Chiaki Tokuda (Tera Effect), Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Directors: Naoki Yamamoto, Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editing Room)

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.

Yasuda launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on June 30.

The manga ranked #12 in the male reader list of the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

title: Spirit Circle TV Anime Announced for December 2026, Reveals Cast and First Trailer
content:
Satoshi Mizukami’s Spirit Circle manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the release date set for December 2026. A teaser visual and first promotional video were revealed alongside the announcement.

The anime will run for 18 episodes and follows Fuuta Okeya, a 14-year-old boy who can see ghosts, and transfer student Kouko Ishigami. After Kouko notices the strange mark hidden beneath the bandage on Fuuta’s cheek, she reveals that the two are connected through multiple past lives and begins targeting him over a grudge carried across reincarnations.

The announced cast includes:

• Kazuki Ura as Fuuta Okeya

• Anna Nagase as Kouko Ishigami

• Eri Yukimura as Rune

• Yuichi Nakamura as East

Anna Nagase also performs the ending theme, “Koko ga Donna Sekai demo,” marking her first solo vocal performance.

Tatsuo Sato serves as director and series composer, with Kentaro Mizuno as assistant director and Satoru Fujimoto handling character design. NAGOMI and EOTA are co-producing the animation, with TWIN ENGINE producing the series.

Sato, known for works including Martian Successor Nadesico , Bodacious Space Pirates , and Stellvia , passed away in April 2026. Spirit Circle became his final work as director. Production continued under Mizuno and the rest of the staff, who completed the series while carrying forward Sato’s direction for the project.

Spirit Circle was serialized in Young King OURs from 2012 to 2016 and concluded with six volumes. Satoshi Mizukami is also known as the creator of Lucifer and the Biscuit Hammer and Planet With . Seven Seas Entertainment licenced Spirit Circle in English, describing the story: Fuuta Okeya can see ghosts. Besides that—and the bandage he always keeps on his cheek—he’s a perfectly normal 14-year old boy enamoured with the new transfer student. Unfortunately, Kouko Ishigami wants little to do with him. A strange ghost that follows her, however, seems to feel quite differently. But, when Kouko sees the strange birthmark hidden beneath the bandage on Fuuta’s cheek, she has a change of heart…for the worse. Not only does she denounce him as her enemy, but she claims that the birthmark is a curse she engraved upon his face during one of their many past lives. What happened between Kouko and Fuuta, and what is the connection to the strange, fantastical dreams that Fuuta begins to experience?
author: Anime Corner

title: Senren * Banka Anime Reveals TV Format
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the anime adaptation of Yuzu Soft 's Senren * Banka visual novel opened on Thursday and revealed its television format. The staff also announced that the game has exceeded 1 million copies in worldwide cumulative sales, and presented an illustration by original character designer Kobuichi to celebrate the feat.

The software's cast members Sora Haruka ( Eri Sendai ), Yūki Kotorii ( Natsumi Takamori ), Mikan Satō ( Nozomi Yamamoto ), and Sawa Sawasawa ( Atsumi Tanezaki ) are all reprising their roles as Yoshino Tomotake, Mako Hitachi, Murasame, and Lena Liechtenauer, respectively. KOTOKO is performing the anime's opening theme song after doing the same for the visual novel.

The anime will premiere in 2027.

Yuzu Soft released the visual novel in Japan in July 2016 in celebration of the company's 10th anniversary. Sekai Project announced in July 2017 that it will release the game in English, but Nekonyan announced in 2018 that it will release the visual novel in English instead. Nekonyan released the game in English in February 2020. The game released on the Switch in May 2022.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Spirit Circle' Gets TV Anime in December 2026
content:
Production company Twin Engine opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Satoshi Mizukami 's Spirit Circle manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), the ending theme, and first promotional video. The anime series is scheduled to premiere in December 2026, with a total of 18 episodes.

Cast Fuuta Okeya: Kazuki Ura ( Tougen Anki ) Kouko Ishigami: Anna Nagase ( Koori no Jouheki ) Rune: Eri Yukimura ( Leadale no Daichi nite ) East: Yuuichi Nakamura ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) Vann Flantyr: Kazuki Ura Flors: Kazuki Ura Fone: Kazuki Ura Fortuna: Kazuki Ura Iwana: Anna Nagase Houtarou Kajima: Kazuki Ura Kouko: Anna Nagase Lafalle: Kazuki Ura Lapis: Anna Nagase Fuuko Okeya: Kazuki Ura Raven-Haired Witch: Anna Nagase Roca: Anna Nagase Kousuke Shakuji: Anna Nagase Stona: Anna Nagase

Staff Director, Series Composition: Tatsuo Satou ( Madan no Ou to Vanadis ) Assistant Director: Kentarou Mizuno ( Rocket Girls ) Character Design: Satoru Fujimoto ( Senki Zesshou Symphogear G ) Studio: EOTA , Nagomi Production: Twin Engine

Voice actress Anna Nagase ( Yuurei Deco ) is performing the ending theme "Koko ga Donna Sekai demo," which was previewed in the first promotional video below.

Mizukami serialized the supernatural fantasy manga in Young King OURs magazine from May 2012 to March 2016. Shounen Gahousha published the sixth and final volume in June 2016, concluding the manga after 45 chapters. The manga has a cumulative 800,000 copies of its volumes in circulation.

The manga was published digitally as an English simulpub by Crunchyroll Manga in January 2014. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga for physical English release in January 2017. The sixth volume went on sale in January 2019.

Spirit Circle was nominated in the best comic category for the 48th Seiun Award in 2017.

Synopsis Fuuta Okeya, a 14-year-old student, can see ghosts and wears a bandage on his left cheek to hide his striking birthmark. One day, a girl with a scar on her forehead named Kouko Ishigami, accompanied by a ghost of a tall and friendly man, transfers into his class.

Fuuta quickly takes a liking to Kouko, wondering if it might be love at first sight. After waking up crying from a strange dream involving her, he feels a nostalgic connection to Kouko and becomes determined to befriend her. However, a chain of events forces Fuuta to reveal his birthmark to Kouko, to which she declares him to be the enemy of her life. A furious Kouko explains that the two are bound by reincarnation, and that Fuuta's birthmark is a curse she engraved on him in one of their past lives to recognize and eventually defeat him.

Kouko brings out a circular object made of flames known as the "spirit circle" and attacks Fuuta, pushing him off a flight of stairs. As he falls, Fuuta is thrown back into the insight of one of his previous lives. Spirit Circle chronicles Fuuta's journey back and forth through his several past lives as he gradually unravels the mysteries behind his apparent bad blood with Kouko. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: 'Code Geass: Hoshi Oi no Aspal' Announces Main Cast, Additional Staff
content:
The official website for the Code Geass: Hoshi Oi no Aspal ( Code Geass: Star Chaser Aspal ) new anime series revealed the main cast, additional staff, and the main visual (pictured) on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027, with advance screenings beginning in January 2027.

Voice actors Ivan Shibata ( Kaijuu 8-gou ) and Hibiku Yamamura ( Pon no Michi ) are starring in the anime as Aspal and Zoé, respectively.

Staff Assistant Director: Shinnosuke Itou ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: GQuuuuuuX episode director) Sub Character Design: Yumiko Nakamura ( Overlord Movie 3: Sei Oukoku-hen ), Madoka Hirayama ( Nihon e Youkoso Elf-san. character design), Kumi Horii ( Kenja no Deshi wo Nanoru Kenja character design), Hiroo Nagao ( Hotel Inhumans chief animation director), Moaang ( Fujimoto Tatsuki 17-26 character design) Closed Soul Design: Isasa Cockpit Design: Hisayoshi Kijima Effect Design: Kanta Suzuki Concept Design: Lin Xuanwen Zenex Design: Entei Ryu Design Works: Ichibou Setting Research: Seiichi Shirato Art Director: Yoshio Tanioka ( Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen ) Color Design: Naomi Nakano ( Tongari Boushi no Atelier ) 3DCG Director: Naoyuki Shigekawa Director of Photography: Kenji Fujita ( Houseki no Kuni ) Editing: Kengo Shigemura ( City The Animation ) Sound Director: Kisuke Koizumi ( Liar Game ) Sound Production: dugout Music: Taro Iwashiro ( Seikaisuru Kado )

Kazuya Nomura ( Yuukoku no Moriarty ) is directing the anime at Sunrise . Mado Nozaki ( Hello World screenplay) is handling the series composition. Rolua is designing the characters.

The original Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion ) television anime premiere in 25 episodes in Fall 2006, followed by the second season, Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch R2 ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2 ), in Spring 2008. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subs and dubs in multiple languages.

The first anime movie in the franchise titled Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch I - Koudou ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion I - Initiation ) premiered in Japanese theatres in October 2017, followed by second movie in February 2018, and third movie in May 2018. The Code Geass: Fukkatsu no Lelouch ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection ) sequel movie premiered in February 2019.

The Code Geass: Dakkan no Rozé ( Code Geass: Rozé of the Recapture ) anime series premiered in 12 episodes from June 2024 to September 2024.

The first anime movie in the franchise titled Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch I - Koudou ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion I - Initiation ) premiered in Japanese theatres in October 2017, followed by second movie in February 2018, and third movie in May 2018. The Code Geass: Fukkatsu no Lelouch ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection ) sequel movie premiered in February 2019.
The Code Geass: Dakkan no Rozé ( Code Geass: Rozé of the Recapture ) anime series premiered in 12 episodes from June 2024 to September 2024.

title: Satoshi Mizukami's Spirit Circle Manga Gets TV Anime in December
content:
REMOW announced on Thursday the 18-episode television anime adaptation of Satoshi Mizukami 's Spirit Circle manga , which will air in Japan and also stream globally in December. The announcement also revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, teaser visual, main cast, and staff members. The video announces and previews the ending theme song "No Matter the World" (Koko ga Donna Sekai Demo) by Anna Nagase . The song is specifically written for the series.

The anime will star:

Kazuki Ura as Fuuta Okeya

Anna Nagase as Kouko Ishigami

Eri Yukimura as Rune

Yūichi Nakamura as East

The anime is directed by the late Tatsuo Satō ( Martian Successor Nadesico , Stellvia , Atom The Beginning ), as his final directorial work at NAGOMI and EOTA . Satō was also in charge of the anime's series scripts. The anime's production was completed under the leadership of assistant director Kentaro Mizuno ( Cardfight!! Vanguard overDress , Yu-Gi-Oh! Go Rush!! , Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode director). Satoru Fujimoto is designing the characters, and TWIN ENGINE is producing the anime.

REMOW describes the story:

Confronted with a grave sin committed by his own soul... Fuuta Okeya is a middle school student who can see spirits. His life is turned upside down when he meets Kouko Ishigami, a mysterious transfer student. "I'll destroy your soul and break the cycle of reincarnation." Kouko reveals that the two share a fateful connection stretching back to their previous lives. Why is Kouko after his life? And why must he fight her? Determined to uncover the truth, Fuuta embarks on an extraordinary journey through his past lives, traveling across time and space—from the distant ancient past to the far future. When all the secrets are finally revealed, will their intertwined destinies lead to destruction... or salvation?

Mizukami ( The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer , Sengoku Youko ) began Spirit Circle in Shōnengahōsha 's Young King Ours in May 2012, and ended the series in 2016. Shōnengahōsha shipped the sixth and final compiled volume in June. Crunchyroll began simultaneous publication of the manga in 2014. Seven Seas Entertainment published the manga physically in English.

Mizukami's The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer manga inspired an anime adaptation in 2022. Mizukami's Sengoku Youko manga inspired a three- cours (quarter of a year) anime adaptation in 2024.

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Unveils Additional Cast Pair
content:
The official website for the new Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) television anime announced additional cast pair on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 7 at 11.45 p.m. on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame.

Voice actors Shinichiro Miki ( Youjo Senki ) and Megumi Toyoguchi ( Mushoku Tensei ) joined the cast as Umi's father and Umi's mother, respectively.

Yui Umemoto ( Ninja Kamui ) is directing at E&H Production , with Takayuki Sano ( Bullet/Bullet episode director) is serving as the assistant director. Shigeru Murakoshi ( Apocalypse Hotel ) is handling the series composition and Satomi Watanabe ( Aikatsu! ) is designing the characters. Yuki Kajiura ( Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica ), Takumi Ozawa ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ), and Shiho Terada ( Inazuma Eleven Go ) are composing the music.

CLAMP serialized the manga in Nakayoshi magazine from November 1993 to February 1995. A sequel manga began in the same month and ended in March 1996.

Tokyopop licensed both manga in 1997, followed by Dark Horse Comics in 2009, and then Kodansha USA in 2019 with two hard-cover box sets containing three volumes each.
